payload.report_excerpt: Speculative decoding with a draft model one twentieth the size of the target gives a 2.4x median throughput gain at unchanged output distribution [Nadia, 2022].
payload.source_excerpt: Cross-encoder reranking of the top 100 bi-encoder candidates improves recall@5 by 7.8 points and adds 190ms of median latency; reranking the top 20 adds 41ms for a 4.1 point gain.
